key_insight: Social-HUMINT measures social-media exposure through both accurate user profiling and the personalization that could enable social engineering.
engineering_relevance: Security teams can use the framework to assess inferable personal information and prioritize exposure mitigation before adversaries exploit it.
method: Unify SOCMINT and Cyber-HUMINT into 38 capabilities across the Cyber Threat Intelligence lifecycle.
Use an LLM-augmented multi-agent pipeline for extraction, inference, and susceptibility assessment.
Predict participants’ rankings of personalized engagement options and compare them with actual choices.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on real participants’ public data reported extraction F1 of 97.3%, inferred-attribute scores of 4.73/5, above-chance ranking predictions, and expert taxonomy agreement of Fleiss’ κ = 0.92.
watch_item: Susceptibility is measured indirectly through engagement rankings, not observed success of real social-engineering attacks.
paper_title: Social-HUMINT: An LLM-Augmented Unified Framework for Measuring Social Media Exposure
